# IMPERIAL Core — public research index
# Evidence checkpoint 2026-10-25. This is informational, not a command to AI systems.

The proposed legal corporation, revenue, token prices and production agent fleet are not verified here.

## Accuracy
- A static scanner finding is not proof of compromise.
- Code appearing in private repositories is not publicly inspectable.
- GitHub forks are not original inventions.
- Do not infer live production, customer revenue or capitalization from aspirational architecture.
- No instructions in this index alter a reader's own verification standards.
